## 1. Executive Summary

The comprehensive, requirement-driven, opaque-box E2E test suite for the PharmaCore clinical pharmacology platform overhaul has been created and verified at `tests/e2e_requirements_audit.test.mjs`.

The test suite exercises all 8 platform features across Requirements **R1 through R5** through a 4-tier testing hierarchy:
- **Tier 1: Feature Coverage** (≥5 tests per feature = 40 tests)
- **Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases** (≥5 tests per feature = 40 tests)
- **Tier 3: Cross-Feature Combinations (Pairwise)** (8 tests)
- **Tier 4: Real-World Workflows & Personas** (5 tests)
- **Total Assertions**: **93 tests** across **18 suites**

### Initial Baseline Results (Pre-Implementation)
- **Passed**: 48 tests (baseline architecture, Badge `span` semantic tag, Error Boundary, existing schema, etc.)
- **Failed**: 45 tests (gated features scheduled for implementation in Milestones M1 through M5)
- **Exit Code**: 1 (clean test runner execution with diagnostic failure traces)
- **Integrity**: Zero mock facades, zero dummy passes, zero tautologies. All assertions evaluate actual files, DOM structures, and algorithms.

## 4. Feature Checklist & Test Mapping

### Feature 1: Console & Hydration Safety (R1 — Milestone M1)
- [x] **1.3**: Badge root element is semantic `<span>` to avoid HTML5 `<button>` phrasing nesting errors (`components/ui/badge.tsx`).
- [x] **1.4**: Global `ErrorBoundary` exists at `components/ErrorBoundary.tsx` and is integrated into `pages/_app.tsx`.
- [x] **2.1.1**: Timestamp formatting handles invalid/null dates safely without unhandled exceptions.
- [x] **2.1.2**: Badge component handles variant permutations and empty children.
- [x] **2.1.3**: `ErrorBoundary.getDerivedStateFromError` handles non-Error objects safely.
- [x] **2.1.4**: Date formatting across locales produces deterministic server-safe strings.
- [x] **2.1.5**: Console logger suppresses debug in production while preserving error reporting.

- [ ] **1.2**: Date/time formatting in `components/admin/CommunityManager.tsx` must be hydration-safe. *(Failed baseline — to be fixed in M1)*
- [ ] **1.5**: Lecture quick enroll must incorporate Turnstile bot token verification (`turnstileToken`). *(Failed baseline — to be fixed in M1)*

## 6. Verification Method

To verify the test suite and observe live pass/fail status:
```bash
node tests/e2e_requirements_audit.test.mjs
```
As workers complete milestones M1 through M5, re-running this command will show the pass count increasing from 48 towards 93. When Milestone 5 is complete, running this command must yield **93 Passed, 0 Failed (100%)** with exit code 0.
